numbers.label: Number 31
numbers.instruction: Begin in '3' base handshape (Thumb, Index, Middle extended; Ring and Pinky tucked), then transition to Index finger upright ('1').

numbers.label: Number 32
numbers.instruction: Begin in '3' base handshape, then transition to '2' handshape (Index and Middle fingers upright).

numbers.label: Number 33
numbers.instruction: Hold '3' handshape (Thumb, Index, Middle extended upright) and bounce forward or outward twice.

numbers.label: Number 34
numbers.instruction: Begin in '3' base handshape, then extend 4 fingers upright (Index, Middle, Ring, Pinky) with thumb tucked flat against palm.

numbers.label: Number 35
numbers.instruction: Begin in '3' base handshape, then open and flare all 5 fingers wide with thumb fully extended outward.

numbers.label: Number 36
numbers.instruction: Begin in '3' base handshape, unfold Ring finger, and touch Thumb tip to Pinky tip ('6' handshape).

numbers.label: Number 37
numbers.instruction: Begin in '3' base handshape, then touch Thumb tip to Ring tip ('7' handshape).

numbers.label: Number 38
numbers.instruction: Begin in '3' base handshape, then touch Thumb tip to Middle tip ('8' handshape).

numbers.label: Number 39
numbers.instruction: Begin in '3' base handshape, then touch Thumb tip to Index tip with remaining 3 fingers upright ('9' handshape).

numbers.label: Number 40
numbers.instruction: Begin in '4' base handshape (Index, Middle, Ring, Pinky upright with thumb tucked), then actively close/pulse fingers into an 'O' shape.
